convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1, per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; states.json pixelThreshold 0.03 is the Gate-1 story-vs-baseline knob, not this loop's). Targets = NORMALIZED prototype, Playwright 1.58 Chromium headless-shell 151, deviceScaleFactor 2 (matches pen export scale 2), --disable-lcd-text --font-render-hinting=none, Heebo + Noto Serif (upright + italic) served from the same TTFs the .pen references (pencil/designs/fonts/, via @font-face), fonts.ready + double-rAF quiescence, transitions frozen (duration 0). Contract steps driven verbatim through Playwright locators (click/press/fill+blur/waitMs, nth-scoped); deck-option states drive the demo-controls surrogate exactly as contracted. Root clip = state.prototype.root border box, integer-snapped (#iv-intake; modal states clip the body-mounted .iv-modal panel itself per the contract ROOT OVERRIDE). Viewports 1280x1400 (default) / 480x1100 (narrow-stacked) per states.json; for states whose root extends below the viewport bottom the target renderer grows the viewport HEIGHT before the clip (width unchanged - tiers are width-keyed by contract, rule 27) since a Playwright clip truncates at the viewport edge. 21/21 states rendered with zero page errors.
convergence.iterationNotes: Iteration 1 (authored from paint-ordered scene graphs of the normalized prototype: per-line Range text boxes with canvas fontBoundingBoxAscent baseline estimation + the GC-006 hhea placement model, svg shape harvest incl. dasharray-arc conversion, synthesized input value/placeholder text, modeled range-input track/fill/thumb, nested clip frames for viewport/menu/modal overflow): 20/21 states 0.098-0.660% - already under budget everywhere the target rendered; one uncounted infra correction to the compare harness's TARGET renderer, not the .pen (narrow-stacked's root extends below the 1100px story viewport and the Playwright clip truncated the target to 80 CSS px - viewport-height growth fix, same class as GC-011's target-renderer correction). tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: current progress circle (the 20x8 accent pill, every deck frame)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Role-first the surface is the ACTIVE PAGINATION DOT - Hemlock owns that role as sem-paginationDotActive, but its value is gray-700 #403D3A (dark navylight-600), directly contradicting Bill's deliberate accent treatment (rule 11: 'current circle is a 20x8 --accent pill'). Binding the existing role would silently repaint the deck's primary position indicator gray; hue-matching another accent role (background-action) would mis-name the role. Created the component token carrying Bill's pair (light #3A6AF8 / dark #5A82F9 - the template's dark --accent exactly) per the never-stop gap doctrine; the adopt-vs-remap binary is designGaps[0].

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: rest progress circles (8x8, every deck frame)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Role- AND value-exact: Hemlock's pagination-dot role resolves gray-200 #D5D3D0, exactly Bill's rest-dot fill. Deliberately bound the pagination role rather than a border role - the dot is a pagination affordance, not a border. Recorded (not silent) because the same raw value binds three different roles in this component by surface (divider -> sem-borders-muted, rest dots -> sem-paginationDot, slider track -> sem-sliderTrack).

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: caret buttons (36px circles, accent outline + accent chevron on surface fill)

tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: The prototype names the treatment ('accent outline, matching the secondary-button treatment', rule 1). GC-006 precedent verbatim: Hemlock's Button/secondary border is pale blue-300 - binding it would repaint the kit's documented full-accent outline idiom. Borders bind the action border role, glyphs the action icon role; the idiom divergence is re-affirmed as a non-token gap (GC-006 already carries it).

Bill's focus ring is the accent, not Hemlock's near-black sem-borders-focus - repainting the ring black would materially rewrite the deck's documented focus design (rule 13). Same class of idiom conflict GC-006 recorded for its accent-subtle wash rings; captured faithfully on the action-border role and re-affirmed as a non-token gap. The ring's top segment extends above the contract root and is clipped by the frame exactly as the element capture clips it - rendered truth.

GC-006 --pos precedent verbatim: green-500 #148338 is value-exact on sem-text-deposit. sem-icons-success considered and rejected - it resolves green-400 #1EBF51, a visibly lighter repaint of Bill's tone, and the glyph rides the done-head text line as one unit with the serif title.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: graphic-mode motif paints (spark motif framed in graphic-display-mode: accent line + accent-subtle area fill)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: The motifs are decorative chart-shaped graphics (role=presentation, rule 23) whose authored intent is the chart ramp (FLAG-D1 names --seq3..--seq7). Both values are ramp-exact (seq-600 = blue-600 #3A6AF8, seq-100 = blue-100 #EBF0FE), so binding the sequential-ramp roles banks the rendered truth AND keeps the ramp intent addressable when the land stage takes up D1. Non-motif accent-subtle surfaces (logo glyph fill, selected dropdown item wash) bind $y:sem-background-highlight instead - same value, different role. The bars/donut motifs are not visible in any contracted frame (the framed graphic state shows card 2's authored spark).
